items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São Luís (MA) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through electronic pregão (reverse auction), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,369,661.52; proposals close Nov 19, 10:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
